description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Garen''' rapidly spins his sword around himself 7 (+ 1 per 25% '''bonus''' attack speed) times over 3 seconds, becoming [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable]] to declare basic attacks but gaining [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosting]] and dealing physical damage to nearby enemies periodically. ''Judgment'' can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.
description.text: Active: Garen rapidly spins his sword around himself 7 (+ 1 per 25% bonus attack speed) times over 3 seconds, becoming unable to declare basic attacks but gaining ghosting and dealing physical damage to nearby enemies periodically. Judgment can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.

description2.raw: Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with [[File:Armor penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Armor penetration]] 25% armor reduction for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.
description2.text: Enemy champions hit 6 times by Judgment are inflicted with  25% armor reduction for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.

description3.raw: ''Judgment'' deals 25% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.
description3.text: Judgment deals 25% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.

description5.raw: ''Judgment'' can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] for「 (130% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|9%]]) damage. 」「 [[File:Critical strike damage icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] 30% '''bonus''' critical damage. 」
description5.text: Judgment can critically strike for「 (130% +  9%) damage. 」「  30% bonus critical damage. 」

notes.text:
At level 20, Garen will spin a minimum of 9 times.
Deactivating the ability manually does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Each spin triggers a stack of Conqueror.
For the purpose of moving closer to an enemy when right clicking them, Judgment also reduces Garen's  attack range 「 to 100 」「 by 75 」 for the duration.
Judgment only scales with bonus attack speed from items and growth (per level).
Judgment cancels Garen's last movement command upon ending.
Each spin deals damage simultaneously to all enemies within its range when the spin is completed.
The spin animation is capped at 200% bonus attack speed, but the amount of ticks will keep on scaling.
The armor reduction stacks multiplicatively with other percentage armor penetration effects.
